blocks.text: These references identify geology, ecology, scale, light, architecture, movement, and lived use that artists can study. They are not literal claims that a human country, monument, or culture was copied into the Codex. A Cyberpath location may resemble a real place because the DBA inherited human archives, because similar problems produce similar forms, because World Fold Stewards joined compatible systems, or because the External Gate translates an unfamiliar structure into imagery a player can understand.
